title: Minimum Xor Pair Query
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 3 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 1\leq Q \leq 3\times 10^5; 0\leq x < 2 ^{30}; When a query 2 is given, at least one x is written on the blackboard.; When a query 3 is given, at least two integers are written on the blackboard.; All input values are integers.
